_comment: City warp-pad dressing layout (special_c3 set). Authored in the web mock at #/teleporter-mock and consumed by scripts/3d/elements/teleporter_dressing.gd. Positions are offsets from `anchor` (world frame, matches the s00e_sa2 stage GLB); each piece is re-pivoted to its bbox bottom-center before the offset applies. `scroll` = UV offset speed in units/sec; `uv.wrap` per axis is mirror|repeat|clamp; `uv.rot` is radians.
